name: io.github.thanathe/shippop-mcp
description: SHIPPOP (Thailand) shipping: check price, book, confirm, label, track, cancel, pickup; plus crossborder orders.

environmentVariables.name: SHIPPOP_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Email of the SHIPPOP account that owns the key

environmentVariables.name: SHIPPOP_INTER_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: SHIPPOP account login email — enables crossborder tools

environmentVariables.name: SHIPPOP_INTER_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: SHIPPOP account login password — enables crossborder tools

environmentVariables.name: SHIPPOP_LABEL_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory where label PDFs are written
